name: Camp Woonasquatucket
description_short: Half-day (9 AM–12 PM) week-long environmental education camp at the Leo Bouchard Conservation Center in Smithfield, RI. Campers hike, observe wildlife and bugs, do water and soil science, make nature crafts, and work on conservation projects. Sessions alternate between ages 8–10 and 11–13.
activities: Nature crafts with upcycled and natural materials
swim_waterfront_notes: The center has a waterfront on Stillwater Reservoir and a kayak and canoe launch. The page mentions campers will "splash around" and look at aquatic life. It does not say whether there is swimming, boating, or lifeguard supervision.

warnings: This is an old season. The page is a WRWC blog post dated March 7, 2025, and all session dates are for summer 2025, which has already passed (today is 2026-10-13). No 2026 or 2027 dates, prices or ages are shown.
The source is a blog post on the operator's website, not a dedicated camp page or registration page.
Registration goes through the Town of Smithfield Parks & Recreation site, but the link was not included in the source.
The phone number and the address at 45 Eagle Street, Providence are for WRWC's main office, not the camp site.
This is a half-day program (9 AM–12 PM). Each session holds up to 15 campers.
There is a 50% sibling discount for the second child. The $250 tuition is assumed to be per one-week session.
